name: Spacecraft Fire Safety Experiment-II (SAFFIRE-II)
description: Investigated flammability limits and low-speed concurrent/opposed spread across varied oxygen concentrations (up to 28% O2) in an uncrewed orbiting Cygnus OA-5 spacecraft. Assessed NASA STD-6001 Test 1 material flammability correlations in microgravity.
subresearch_area: Solid Material Flammability & Oxygen Concentration Limits
platform: Cygnus OA-5 Cargo Spacecraft (S.S. Alan Poindexter)
facility: Cygnus Microgravity Flow Duct (100 cm x 50 cm)
apparatus: Low-speed flow duct, 9 material sample cards, infrared radiometers, HD video cameras, thermocouple rake
